links.note: The unit degree Celsius and how it is written is 33276's content - the scale capitalised because it is a name, the word degree not.
A bound on normal human body temperature belongs with 33275, the concept that fixes the normal value; the 35 degree floor itself is not in the concept text.
Degree Fahrenheit and its symbol - 33276, where the units and their spelling are set out.
The kelvin as SI unit - the fact 33275 delivers.
Absolute zero at -273.15 degrees Celsius is the offset 33277 uses to convert to kelvin, the gap between the two zeros.
Temperature as the reliable measure, and a hotter body having the higher temperature - section 7.1 in 33270.
That 37.0 is an average rather than every person's value is the point of 33274's activity, which measures several people because one reading cannot show what is typical.
Why touch misleads, with the two-hands activity as the demonstration - 33270 in full.
